defining_evidence: Official contract/funds-flow record; statutory report naming 委託; or official project report naming 受託者
financial_meaning: May indicate commissioned work; amount is payment only when official funds-flow/contract says so
examples: KIP; JICA teacher training; prefectural multicultural meeting support; youth exchange consortium
what_it_explains: How NGOs and consortia operate public programs under administrative assignment
prohibited_inference: Do not call all project costs contract payments or movement funding.

defining_evidence: Official list appoints organization to an institutional service role
financial_meaning: Role may be commissioned but no amount is inferred without award/contract/report
what_it_explains: Institutional access and continuity beyond one event
prohibited_inference: Designation is not a grant and does not prove the amount paid.

defining_evidence: Official narrative says subsidy/grant is provided to named organization
financial_meaning: Confirms grant relation; amount still needs an award decision if the table only gives whole project cost
examples: Okinawa Prefecture international exchange/cooperation promotion subsidy
what_it_explains: A resource channel different from procurement/commission
prohibited_inference: Do not relabel whole project cost as award amount.

defining_evidence: Official program/facility page or collaboration table documents service delivery
financial_meaning: Can be non-financial evidence of function; avoid double-counting when a commission row also exists
examples: KIP consultations/language classes/events; Uchinanchu network operations
what_it_explains: Observed public function and beneficiary-facing role
prohibited_inference: Service role does not imply political stance or a separate funding flow.

defining_evidence: Official minutes or collaboration record confirms participation without a transfer instrument
financial_meaning: No funding is inferred; project-wide cost may be retained only as contextual field
examples: ONC meeting secretariat; Okinawa Peace Cooperation Center joint implementation
prohibited_inference: Co-presence or joint implementation is not funding.

defining_evidence: Same program appears in payer-side and organization-side documents with different accounting labels/amounts
financial_meaning: Keep records separate until period scope tax and accounting bases are reconciled
examples: FY2024 KIP JPY16.662m municipal commission flow vs JPY16.04m ONC project cost; prefecture multicultural JPY5.14m vs JPY5.53m
prohibited_inference: Never average choose or sum discrepant figures without reconciliation.

defining_evidence: Official collaboration table names a public unit program and partner but does not expose a transfer instrument
financial_meaning: Confirms institutional collaboration; whole-project cost remains contextual only
examples: Okinawa Prefecture Base Affairs Division and New Diplomacy Initiative symposium program
what_it_explains: How an advocacy actor can enter a public information/program venue without proving a funding chain
prohibited_inference: Do not call the project-cost field an amount paid to the partner or movement funding.
